channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Earthquake of magnitude-3.9 recorded in Vietnam’s Quang Ngai
item.description: A magnitude-3.9 earthquake struck Mang But Commune in Quang Ngai Province, central Vietnam on Monday, according to the Institute of Earth Sciences.

item.title: Toppled tree cuts power on downtown street in Da Nang
item.description: A large roadside tree was suddenly uprooted on Monday night, causing a power outage on Phan Chau Trinh Street in downtown Da Nang City, central Vietnam.

item.title: Vietnam cuts fuel import tax to 0% until next month
item.description: The Vietnamese government has issued Decree 72 reducing import tariffs on several fuel products to zero percent, effective from March 9 through April 30, in an effort to stabilize the domestic fuel market amid escalating tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: How much oil do G7 countries hold in emergency reserves?
item.description: PARIS -- The Group of Seven countries are considering releasing emergency oil stocks to address the Middle Eastern supply crisis, the International Energy Agency said on Monday, as oil prices surged to as high as almost $120 per barrel.

item.title: IEA called for emergency oil stock release at G7 meeting, Japan says
item.description: TOKYO - The International Energy Agency (IEA) called for a coordinated release of emergency oil reserves during an online meeting with Group of Seven finance ministers on Monday, Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama told a briefing.

item.title: Vietnam ministry urges reduced private vehicle use, remote work amid fuel supply concerns
item.description: The Vietnamese Ministry of Industry and Trade has warned of possible localized fuel shortages and urged residents and businesses to reduce fuel consumption, including limiting private vehicle use and increasing remote work, as tensions in the Middle East threaten global energy supplies.

item.title: Vietnam mobilizes 4 million barrels of oil to secure energy supply
item.description: Vietnam has mobilized some four million barrels of oil from international partners to ensure short-term fuel supply stability as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East continue to raise concerns about global energy markets, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh said on Monday.

item.title: Abandoned Boeing at Hanoi airport to be used as training aircraft
item.description: A Boeing 727-200 that has sat at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi for 18 years will be transferred to the Vietnam Aviation Academy for use as a training aircraft.

item.title: Video shows foreign tourist kicking pet dog at Da Nang spa, leaving it with broken ribs
item.description: A video circulating on social media in recent days has triggered widespread anger after showing a man, believed to be a foreign tourist, violently kicking a small dog in Da Nang despite the animal showing no signs of aggression.
